    while i < len(lines):
        s = lines[i].strip()
        if s == '{':
            br = 0

                for c in lines[j]:
                    if c == '{': br += 1
                    elif c == '}': br -= 1

                    try: objs.append(json.loads('\n'.join(jl)))
